errors.evidence: The description states the starting value for revenue in 2017 is 2.2 billion dollars, but the figure clearly shows the value is 102.2 billion dollars.

The description refers to the growth data as an 'orange area' ('оранжева площ'). However, the figure displays this data as a series of percentage values along the upper line of the blue area, not as a second filled area.
The description claims that the growth rate ('растежа') 'gradually increases'. This is incorrect; the growth rate fluctuates year-on-year (e.g., 31% in 2018, 16% in 2019, 22% in 2020, 10% in 2021).
The description incorrectly assigns the growth value of 31% to the year 2019. According to the figure, the 31% growth occurred in 2018, while the growth in 2019 was 16%.
The description of the growth percentages is incomplete. It omits several values shown on the chart, such as 16% for 2019 and 22% for 2020.
